instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the most exciting adjectives to make an expanded noun phrase that describes the picture.

hint.text: Adjectives describe the noun in the noun phrase.
hint.label: Adjectives

atoms.b: a ((++tremendous fluffy girly)), ((++erupting tickling smiling)) volcano in the distance
one ((++excited miserable sad)), ((++young old swimming)) girl at the airport
the ((++colossal big small)), ((++wise tiny yellow)) elephant next to a tree
multiple ((++fluffy blue shiny)), ((++adorable miniature green)) lambs on the farm

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the most suitable prepositional phrase to make an expanded noun phrase that describes the picture.

hint.text: Prepositional phrases can give us extra information about the noun we are describing, such as its position, or some extra detail about its appearance.
hint.label: Prepositional phrases

atoms.b: a bright, striking lightning bolt ((++over_the_meadow above_the_house underneath_the_water))
one fast, blaring ambulance ((++on_the_motorway in_the_clouds at_the_zoo))
the cute, cheeky chimpanzee ((++with_a_banana on_the_table down_the_path))
a tall, distinct lighthouse ((++by_the_coast on_the_water in_the_house))
